text:
olivia: Starting a short follow-up thread from today's all-hands for security/privacy/compliance Qs (SOC2/ISO, VPC/BYOK, audit logs, KMS, EU residency). Panel: @mari (Head of Security), @raj (CTO), @jeff (Product). Drop quick Qs and we'll reply. :lock:

nina: SOC2 Type II  what's the single ETA Sales should use?

mari: For now, say Q4 2025. Auditor fieldwork planned in an OctNov window; final report expected late Q4. Scope: Hosted API + Redwood-managed Dedicated. Private/on-prem remains customer-controlled for some controls; we provide an evidence bundle and cooperation checklist.

nina: ISO27001 status?

raj: ISO in the roadmap for early 2026 kickoff, target certification H1 2026. We'll map SOC2 controls to reduce gaps.

jeff: BYOK: can customers rotate keys on their schedule without downtime?

mari: Yes. We support cross-account KMS grants and BYOK. Rotations are customer-controlled; recommend envelope encryption and a coordination notice for rotations affecting long-lived sessions.

nina: Minimal KMS grant example?

mari: Example snippet (simplified):

```json
{"Version":"2012-10-17","Statement":[{"Sid":"AllowRedwood","Effect":"Allow","Principal":{"AWS":"arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/RedwoodKMSAccess"},"Action":["kms:Decrypt","kms:GenerateDataKey"],"Resource":"*"}]}
```

olivia: Audit logs  retention and schema?

mari: Hosted default: 365 days (extendable). Dedicated: 365 days included; long-term archival add-on available. Private/on-prem: retention controlled by customer. Exports: ndjson/parquet to S3 or direct stream to SIEM (Splunk/Datadog/Elastic).

nina: Do logs include token counts and model info for billing reconciliation?

jeff: Yes  logs include request_id, customer_id (masked for public exports), model, model_version, prompt_tokens, completion_tokens, latency_ms, route, and decision_reason. We also emit a salted prompt fingerprint for regression correlation (not reversible).

security-bot: Reminder: evidence owners, upload artifacts to the evidence portal by 2025-09-30: https://portal.redwood.com/evidence. :rotating_light:

mari: Follow-up actions: we'll publish a "security starter" pack with control mappings, BYOK cookbook, VPC checklist, and the audit-log schema next week. We'll post links in Confluence and here.

nina: For EU data residency requests, who handles the contract addendum?

mari: Legal + Security. Email legal@redwood.com or ping me; we have a DP addendum template we can reuse.

olivia: Thanks everyone. We'll consolidate into Confluence notes and follow up on customer-specific asks. If urgent, DM the account lead and cc @mari. :thumbsup:
